final_operations_brief:
**Incident Resolution Summary**

A critical disruption occurred when cargo container SH-4002, carrying 550 tons of industrial electronics, was stranded outside the Port of Seattle due to a worker strike. To mitigate delays, an alternative route was selected: ROUTE-SOUTH-02, diverting the shipment to Port-South and warehouse WH-SOUTH-303. This route adds a 72-hour delay, within the 72-hour limit for perishable components. The target storage facility, Southern Distribution Hub, has a utilization rate of 72% and a normal risk tier, ensuring a viable and safe storage solution. The shipment is now on track for delivery, minimizing potential losses and meeting critical deadlines.
